mu_name_from: _enum.h:1514 MODEL_DIVINE_SWORD_OF_ARCHANGEL = MODEL_SWORD + 19, loaded from Item/Sword20.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:623); group 0 number 19 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:156.
why_this_one: The second Statue of Saint (133) carries it over its coffin (ZzzCharacter.cpp:8952-8966; WebZen raises one of the three statues at random, BC_SAINT_STATUE_1 + rand()%3, BloodCastle.cpp:2216) and gives it up when broken; carried back to the Archangel it wins the castle, as the Divine Staff does. A quest item, worn by nobody. docs/blood-castle-port.md.

stats.note: A quest item here, as the Divine Staff of Archangel (Staff11): the statue gives it up and the Archangel takes it back; nobody wears it, and its damage, requirements and class are left out so the card says none. OpenMU's row was drop 86, 220-230, knight; it does not drop from monsters.
